title: echinolobium coronarium
intro: Echinolobium coronarium, commonly known as the "Golden Shower Tree" or "Cassia fistula", is a tropical plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and skin disorders, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Echinolobium coronarium include its use as an antispasmodic and astringent, which help to relieve pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
